publication_rule: A product is publicly listed as supported only when at least one non-expired certification records an exact version, mode, platform, suite, fixture reference, maintainer, and passing result. Empty certifications mean no public product-level support claim. Family fallback remains separately labelled.
capability_rule: A capability block records what a mechanism was observed to produce. It is never certification, never exercised support, and never a public support claim; only a non-expired certification entry can be one. evidence_kind exercised-on-hardware means a real machine produced the named signal on assessed_on and nothing more. A verdict of deterministic-local-capture describes the count, not the trust: no capability block raises the tier ceiling, and D-077 keeps every locally observed mechanism attested-local rather than source-bound. D-100 records that no provider exposes an individual-account attestation path, so provider_attestation is never available for an individual participant.
